advisoryFindings.title: Over-specific dispatcher filename
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider avoiding the hard-coded requirement that the promoted dispatcher must be `src/workflow/index.js` and that `NAMESPACE_SCRIPTS.workflow` must equal `workflow/index`, unless the spec intentionally requires that exact filename.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The tests still exercise the user-facing `sdd-forge workflow --help` route, so this is mainly an implementation-flexibility concern rather than missing acceptance coverage.
